children: Axis Bank Limited Sponsored GDR RegS (NSE:AXISBANK) saw loan growth cool but corporate lending rise as NIMs fell to 3.36%; it added 259,525 credit cards, expanded digital micro‑lending and hospitality finance, set up nine sector CoEs and signed MOUs to boost tourism and MSME lending.
: AXISBANK quarter loan growth slipped from ~23% to ~19% excluding FCNR(B) loans. NIM fell 37 bps YoY to 3.36%, pressure from higher FCNR(B) funding and deposits parked in low-yield assets.
: Axis Bank (AXISBANK) reported a year‑on‑year rise in its domestic corporate loan book for the September quarter, citing higher corporate working‑capital demand and longer shipping timelines.
: Axis Bank (AXISBANK) added 259,525 credit cards in September, up from 32,789 in August. It was the second-largest contributor to September's net card additions, joining HDFC Bank for ~43%.

: AXISBANK expanded digital underwriting and cash-flow lending for micro and informal businesses, enabling rapid small-ticket loan processing and near-instant digital disbursals for existing customers
: AXISBANK launched a hospitality lending program financing new hotel projects, renovations and asset creation, with loan terms aligned to hospitality cash flows to tap India’s tourism demand.
: Axis Bank (AXISBANK) signed MOUs with PHDCCI Tourism & Hospitality and TTAG to tailor banking and finance solutions for hotels, resorts, travel operators and related tourism businesses.
: AXISBANK set up nine Centres of Excellence targeting sectors like tourism, defence and FMCG to develop tailored products for MSMEs and boost sector-focused growth opportunities.
